Thanks for taking the call earlier. We are getting Redwood queued up for the CloudProcure marketplace. Two quick procurement questions to make sure our onboarding checklist is accurate:

1) Do you plan to sell via the marketplace (managed billing through CloudProcure) or via direct Redwood invoices (we can link to your site but need a vendor PO/contact)?

Goal is to have the listing and pricing live by the end of July; appreciate any constraints on PO lead times.

Best,

Hi team,

Thanks for the heads up — logistics below. Long version but trying to be explicit so vendor doesn't get ping-ponged.

Vendor registration (general):
- Return CloudProcure_Vendor_Form.pdf + Redwood_W9.pdf. We should also register Redwood as a vendor in CloudProcure's portal (they requested a primary billing contact and remittance email).
- Required finance docs: W9 (done), bank remittance template (we can send a stub), and SAM.gov registration if marketplace requires federal contracting (not typical but they asked about it).

Billing models:
- Marketplace-managed billing (preferred): CloudProcure invoices the customer and remits per their payout schedule. We need to verify their payout cadence and any marketplace fee (typically 10-20%). For this model, we still need a vendor profile in their system but fewer POs — customers will not issue POs to Redwood directly.
- Direct invoicing (fallback for GCP): If the customer requires a PO to Redwood, they will issue a PO to our billing address. Our canonical PO/invoice routing: Accounts Payable, Redwood Inference, ap-invoices@redwood.com; remit address: 111 Redwood Way, San Francisco, CA 94104. Payment terms: Net 30 (standard) unless finance agrees to alternate.

Doc & portal links:
- CloudProcure vendor portal: https://vendor.cloudprocure.com/register (they'll ask for tax id and remittance email)
- GCP marketplace: for direct listings we may need a Google Cloud Merchant of Record (MOR) setup; confirm whether CloudProcure is acting as MOR or if Redwood will be.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Hannah — return the vendor form with the W9 attached.
2) Connor — please prep a short vendor bank remittance stub and confirm ap-invoices@redwood.com is active.
3) I will check with Legal/Marissa on any marketplace contract terms that materially vary from our standard T&Cs.

If CloudProcure insists on a signed commercial agreement before listing, loop in Marissa and Legal; otherwise the vendor form + W9 should let them start verification.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
